statement: The taker (not the maker) fills a whole ratio 1..65535 of what remains, while the offer is live in the judge's view. Each leg is floor(amount * ratio / 65535) on its own, the arithmetic of DeltaTransformer's applySwap, so a fill the chain would settle at the same ratio moves the same amounts. A fill that takes nothing of a leg is refused (fill_too_small): every fill is a trade. The whole fill (65535) drops the offer. The first fill of a quote is its acceptance (R-SWAP-CONSENT): the taker's want, in whole, is reserved against the taker only if its RCPAN still holds, and a remainder is a clause only if the Account has a clause to spare (too_many_holds).
source: Arthur 10-01 02:53 (D3: two-party swap inside an Account); plan/swap-onchain.md; coordinator 10-01
